metadata.proof: password_change (line 1228) calls set_password() then update_session_auth_hash() which rotates only the current session's hash. All other sessions for the same user on different devices/browsers remain valid with the old session hash. Source: user changes password → Sink: attacker with a previously-obtained session cookie retains access. There is no Session.objects.filter(session_key=...) invalidation or logout of other sessions.
